purpose: Distinct card covers for 20 player and 18 companion definitions; ancient ink-style layered Huacai finishing animation
normalization: Generated covers fit with transparent padding in 512x442 RGBA; original generated sources retained in Codex generated_images; no repainting in normalization

generatedCovers.name: 劈山
generatedCovers.subject: Heavy two-handed descending mountain cleave

generatedCovers.name: 铁门闩
generatedCovers.subject: A very low planted defensive stance, sword held horizontally like a locked iron gate; two massive ink-black gate pillars frame her, rectangular jade barrier and antique-gold crossbar. Strong architectural square silhouette.

generatedCovers.name: 掠影
generatedCovers.subject: An agile sideways evasive step with two pale ghost afterimages trailing to the left; she looks back over shoulder while her sleeve and scarf ribbon swoop diagonally; dry charcoal speed brushstrokes beneath her feet.

generatedCovers.name: 扫叶
generatedCovers.subject: A low sweeping sword strike across the ground, broad shallow jade crescent blowing dozens of golden and teal bamboo leaves sideways; three small ink enemy silhouettes retreat in the far background. Strong horizontal sweep, not ocean waves.

generatedCovers.name: 破锋
generatedCovers.subject: She pierces an enemy's empty cracked dark steel armor breastplate, jade blade emerging through a clean zigzag fracture in the foreground; close bold impact composition, chunks of armor and gold sparks, no blood.

generatedCovers.name: 心魔
generatedCovers.subject: She kneels with sword lowered, her shadow behind her expands into a threatening smoky faceless double with curling dark violet ink tendrils; tense inward emotion, violet very restrained, pale face clearly readable, no gore.

generatedCovers.name: 拨千斤
generatedCovers.subject: She gently redirects a huge descending dark weapon using just the tip of her slim sword, weightless curved jade arc guides the heavy force away; her relaxed one-handed posture sharply contrasts the heavy black diagonal weapon.

generatedCovers.name: 藏锋
generatedCovers.subject: She stands in three-quarter view with her sword almost fully sheathed at her hip, one hand on the hilt, eyes watchful; a small coiled jade glow is concealed inside the scabbard, mist and closed white blossoms, quiet contained strength.

generatedCovers.name: 调息
generatedCovers.subject: Calm seated cross-legged meditation, eyes half closed, sword resting across lap, one gentle jade breathing spiral and a tiny gold leaf hovering at chest; sparse ink bamboo and ivory space, no combat pose.

generatedCovers.name: 流光
generatedCovers.subject: A fast forward airborne lunge along a SINGLE long diagonal jade light streak, sword extended forward, scarf streamers trailing, elongated ink speed lines; bright luminous point at sword tip, light-and-speed silhouette different from basic horizontal thrust.

generatedCovers.name: 行云
generatedCovers.subject: She strides gracefully through three stepping cloud ribbons curled beneath her, sword turned backwards at shoulder, compositional flowing S curve and three tiny suspended golden leaves to suggest continuous rhythm; pale cloud shapes and teal fabric.

generatedCovers.name: 追风
generatedCovers.subject: A low forward sprint with sword held behind body, three tapered jade wind ribbons racing beside her, long ponytail flowing straight back; asymmetric speed silhouette, feet visible and blade opposite from thrust art.

generatedCovers.name: 护盾攻击
generatedCovers.subject: She drives a compact angular jade energy shield forward with her shoulder, sword held tucked behind; the translucent shield is visibly battering a dark rock slab into fragments, aggressive shield bash posture, diamond-like barrier.

generatedCovers.name: 留盾
generatedCovers.subject: She calmly holds both hands around a stable layered jade protective sphere with a small gold knot sealing its lower edge; sword rests upright beside her, two stacked concentric talisman arcs emphasize lasting protection, tranquil guarded posture.

generatedCovers.name: 剑影回护
generatedCovers.subject: Three translucent hovering sword silhouettes form a protective fan behind the swordswoman, who reaches one open hand toward the viewer as if guarding her companion; jade sword-shadow arcs, no circular shield.

generatedCovers.name: 回锋
generatedCovers.subject: At the exact instant of parry, her angled sword intercepts a descending shadow blade and sends a hooked jade countercut back upward; crossed blades, tiny gold impact star and rebound curved arrow of energy, sharp dynamic counterattack.

generatedCovers.name: 随手一斩
generatedCovers.subject: An effortless casual one-handed diagonal flick of the sword, relaxed smiling face, one short thin jade slash, almost no background scenery, loose sleeve movement, clearly a light casual attack.

generatedCovers.name: 衔锋
generatedCovers.subject: She follows a fading previous sword trail and joins her blade into its end to form a linked two-stroke zigzag of jade light; forward leaning partner follow-up, two connected arcs and tiny gold joint.

generatedCovers.name: 引势
generatedCovers.subject: She stands to one side, guiding a bright jade rising current with an open palm toward an EMPTY upright sword in the foreground; supportive anticipation, gold light gathering at the sword tip, no direct strike.

generatedCovers.name: 回护
generatedCovers.subject: She turns backward protectively, one arm extended behind her and her sword guarding to the front, broad teal cloak sheltering a small white flame; returning protective pose and sweeping semicircular fabric.

generatedCovers.name: 守诺
generatedCovers.subject: She holds a small tied jade-and-gold promise cord over her heart while her sword forms a protective arc around an ivory cloth silhouette beside her; warm solemn eyes, gold knot motif prominent, devoted guardianship.

generatedCovers.name: 利落
generatedCovers.subject: A crisp side-profile precise downward single cut, a falling narrow bamboo stem cleanly separated in midair, minimal background ink, neat confident expression, straight short blade gesture rather than heavy mountain cleave.

generatedCovers.name: 同心剑鸣
generatedCovers.subject: Her sword resonates with a SECOND floating sword in parallel, joined by delicate gold concentric sound ripples between their blades; gentle eyes and harmonizing teal ribbons, two blades clearly visible, no duplicate characters.

generatedCovers.name: 拱卫
generatedCovers.subject: Two small jade sword wards stand like sentinels on either side of a luminous upright blade she presents forward, guarded procession with a narrow gold path; simultaneously guarding and empowering, symmetric flanking structure.

generatedCovers.name: 独断
generatedCovers.subject: Alone in a stark vertical ink composition, she plants her sword point downward with a severe decisive expression, one bold descending gold-and-jade slash divides the mist, strong lone upright silhouette.

generatedCovers.name: 霜寒
generatedCovers.subject: She sweeps a blade releasing jade-white crystalline frost over ink-black distant mountain peaks, frost blossoms and pale icy bamboo, cool teal palette with tiny snow specks; distinct cold wide-area magical action.

generatedCovers.name: 磨剑
generatedCovers.subject: She kneels patiently polishing a sheathed-resting blade with an ivory cloth over a smooth ink stone, restrained gold glint on newly honed edge, concentration and stored potential; no attack and no explosions.

generatedCovers.name: 十步
generatedCovers.subject: She walks away in three-quarter rear view, turns her amber eye toward viewer, sword at hip, a chain of ten small fading gold footprints crosses ink mist behind her; stealthy quiet assassin stride with no gore.

generatedCovers.name: 断水
generatedCovers.subject: Her slim blade passes through a falling jade stream that separates around the steel then reconnects below, poised diagonal stroke; flowing water remains uninterrupted, expressive clear ribbon of water, no sea-wave background.

generatedCovers.name: 斩楼兰
generatedCovers.subject: She makes a resolute forward descending cut before distant dry ink desert walls and a torn empty banner, large jade angled blade arc and dusty gold particles, heroic decisive battlefield action, no blood or severed body.

generatedCovers.name: 阴山
generatedCovers.subject: She braces before a high ink mountain pass, planted sword and a wide tall jade wall block three tiny black cavalry silhouettes far behind; clear mountain-gate protective silhouette, no close violent enemies.

generatedCovers.name: 长风
generatedCovers.subject: She stands on a small ink cliff with sword pointing toward a distant tiny ivory sail, long jade wind trails carry gold cloud fragments upward; hopeful open horizon and airborne ribbon motion.

generatedCovers.name: 几人回
generatedCovers.subject: Battle-weary yet determined, she carries a tattered gold-and-teal banner with sword guarding an enduring small warm ivory lantern, scattered silent ink battlefield spears behind; protective resilience and bittersweet hope.

generatedCovers.name: 华彩
generatedCovers.subject: Adult-proportioned original ancient Chinese ink style; dynamic sword finish; not chibi

finisherLayer.usage: Transparent moving character layer only; native ink-paper ribbon, text and swordlight animate independently

provenance.originals: Original generated PNGs are retained at their source paths; normalized derivatives tracked by SHA-256 in raster-qa.json
